# Функция mainAuth {#sec-api-mainAuth .appendix}

``` python
import crypto from 'crypto'

export const mainAuth = (token: string) => {
    if (token === crypto.createHash('sha256').update('bvcxertyuiolkmnbvedhklcvb').digest('hex')) {
        return true
    } else {
        return false
    }
}
```
